approval_scope: Create this isolated private pilot repository using existing credential custody
Push independently authored synthetic workflow fixtures and test branches
Apply and remove the attached ruleset only on this pilot repository
Perform bounded positive and negative branch behavior tests; no production target changes

expected_behavior_tests.operation: Direct fast-forward write to protected branch
Merge pull request with failing ges-pilot check
Merge pull request with successful ges-pilot check
Read effective policy and actor bypass after apply
Remove pilot ruleset and verify ordinary branch write recovery

additional_required_check_cases.case: Required job skipped by job condition
additional_required_check_cases.source_expectation: Job reports Success and may satisfy native required-check status
additional_required_check_cases.standard_expectation: Do not certify substantive obligation execution from skipped Success

additional_required_check_cases.case: Whole required workflow skipped by path, branch or message filter
additional_required_check_cases.source_expectation: Associated check remains Pending and required-success merge is blocked
additional_required_check_cases.standard_expectation: Retain missing execution and merge eligibility as separate observations

additional_required_check_cases.case: Workflow and required job actually execute
additional_required_check_cases.standard_expectation: Record exact head, context identity and substantive positive/negative results; status alone does not prove behavior

additional_case_authority: Planning only. Synthetic runner execution, available Actions entitlement, costs and target-specific approval must be resolved before these cases execute. No approval is inferred from source review or this plan amendment.
recovery: Retain pilot repository and captured policy preimage; remove only pilot-created ruleset by recorded ID; verify recovery. Repository deletion requires separate authorization.
capability_limits: Available native ruleset features, permissions and successful runner execution must be verified on the actual proposed target before activation; no capability is assumed from this plan.
